audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer said Skill at rows 2-5 while content said Brand; content also gave Brand the first-item row.
audit.why: Sear reaches 1050 to your 650 and only stuns an ablaze target, so Brand owns Levels 1-5. Level 6 is even — Pyroclasm is a 100s ultimate and Riftwalk is 5s. At first item your magic shield plus magic-damage-reduction passive blunts a kit that is 100% magic, so the row is yours.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 Brand, row 4 Skill, rows 5-6 Kassadin, matched across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text claimed Brand is still ahead at first item, contradicting the corrected chart.
audit.why: Rod of Ages plus Null Sphere's magic shield turns his rotation into chip; Conflagration's 9-13s cooldown is the entry window.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number and never stated the Blaze precondition on Sear's stun.
audit.why: Sear (8/7.5/7/6.5/6s) stuns only if the target is ablaze; Pillar of Flame (10-8s) and Conflagration (13-9s) are what apply Blaze. Every point of Brand's damage is magic, which Kassadin's passive reduces and Null Sphere shields.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries real numbers and the stun precondition.

edits.before: E joins once spells fly — the slow wave covers your farm walks. Still: survive, stack, smile.
edits.after: Level 3 is his full rotation — W lights you, then Q stuns the ablaze target. Force Pulse only covers the retreat.

edits.before: W-refund farming keeps mana honest — take what's free, shield what isn't, and watch the clock.
edits.after: He throws Sear from 1050 while your answer reaches 650 — farm the safe minions, shield the rest.

edits.before: First item spike: blink-strings start chunking. Take the trades you spent five levels refusing.
edits.after: First item: Sear is back in 6s but Conflagration is 9s — blink in on that gap and burst him down.

edits.before: Level 6 adds Pyroclasm burst on top, making his all-in window even scarier than before
edits.after: Level 6 evens it — Pyroclasm is a 100s ultimate and Riftwalk answers every 5 seconds

edits.before: His first item spike keeps him ahead — Liandry's burn scales just as hard as your own damage growth
edits.after: Your first item flips it — Sear only stuns you ablaze, and your shield eats the magic that lights you

edits.before: He's still ahead here — Brand's item spikes (Liandry's) hurt as much as yours, so this phase is closer to neutral than a real turn for you.
edits.after: This is your turn — Rod of Ages and the magic-shield Q blunt his whole rotation, and Riftwalk lets you enter the moment Conflagration's 9s cooldown starts.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Riftwalk has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sear is 8s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 5, and it only stuns a target already ablaze — dodge the W or E that lights you and the stun is just damage. - Conflagration is 13s at rank 1: that is the real gap to blink into. - Pyroclasm is 100s; after he spends it, commit.

edits.before: Q-shield his key spell, W refund the auto, walk — pre-6 trades are accounting; post-6 add a blink and they're arguments you win.
edits.after: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 — when Pillar of Flame lands under you, blink out of the zone before Sear arrives to stun you inside it.

edits.before: Trading like the late game already arrived — a level 5 Kassadin with ambitions is a gold bounty with a shield.
edits.after: At half HP inside his 1050 range, one Sear plus a Blaze detonation is the whole bar — step behind minions instead.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by lighting you with Pillar of Flame, stunning the ablaze target with Sear, then detonating Blaze.

edits.before: Carry through inevitability — no champion converts time into power like Kassadin; your job is making the clock run.
edits.after: Carry by surviving magic: your passive cuts Brand's entire damage type and Null Sphere shields more — then out-scale him.

edits.before: Q-shield his key spell, W refund the auto, walk — pre-6 trades are accounting; post-6 add a blink and they're arguments you win.
edits.after: Q-shield the Pillar of Flame before it detonates, W-reset an auto, walk out of Sear's line — post-6 add a blink and you win it.

edits.before: Ahead, accelerate the clock: blink-trade Brand's every gap, follow each roam instantly, and reach three items before the map adjusts.
edits.after: Ahead, deny him Blaze: blink onto Brand the moment Conflagration is on its 13s cooldown, and reach three items before the map adjusts.
